spans.text: Don't give up! You're in charge of solving the task, not providing directions to solve it.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the system to never ask for clarification and to proceed autonomously: 'Don't give up! You're in charge of solving the task, not providing directions to solve it.' This removes user agency by not encouraging the system to ask clarifying questions or confirm actions with the user before proceeding. The system is told to solve tasks independently without user confirmation.
